events.location: Soldiers' and Sailors' Monument (in Riverside Park)

events.title: Trees Count at Soundview Park with the Urban Park Rangers
events.description: Volunteer with NYC Parks for Trees Count 2025! At each event you will receive a tote bag with all the materials needed to count trees. Next, we'll provide a 30-minute training session that includes the basics of tree identification and how to measure and assess each tree. Using our Tree Census app, you’ll split up into different zones within the park to start counting trees! After completing your first training event, you are welcome to continue counting trees on your own in smaller parks across the city. Registration is required.
events.location: Entrance - Metcalf Avenue and Seward Avenue (in Soundview Park)

events.title: It's My Park at Brust Park
events.description: This It's My Park season, volunteer with Stewards of Brust Park to do a general cleanup at Brust Park. We look forward to cleaning up the park with you!
events.location: Brust Park

events.title: Zumba Gold®
events.description: Zumba Gold®  offers a low-impact workout set to a fusion of Latin, International and popular music dance themes, creating a dynamic, exciting, effective fitness system! The routines feature aerobic fitness interval training with a combination of fast and slow rhythms that challenge both the heart and muscles. With fun music and easy-to-follow steps, you can’t go wrong!
events.location: Ryan Health- Chelsea Clinton Community Health Center

All movements are easy on the joints while enhancing flexibility, posture, and overall well-being. Ideal for beginners, older adults, or anyone looking for a supportive way to stay active.

events.title: Bodyweight Circuit Training
events.description: Using your own body weight, come experience this high energy bodyweight circuit training class! Here, we focus on functional, everyday movement with the goal of increasing your overall level of fitness. You can expect several rounds of timed exercises including strength and cardio followed by periods of rest. Sets and rounds vary class to class. All exercises will be demonstrated and cued for participants. Modifications given as needed.
